name: Bounty
description: A notice with a price on it. Job boards in settled places carry these.

names: Wanted, and the Wardens are busy: {quarry}
board_lines: {count} of them. Nobody is asking where they came from, only that they go.
Paid on the word of anyone who saw it done. {marks} marks.
Signed with a thumbprint and an apology for the spelling.
The carters have stopped coming through. Work it out.
journal: A notice at {place} puts a price on {quarry} working the roads of {region}. {count} of them, the board says, though boards round off.
{place} is paying for {count} of the {quarry} that have made the {region} road a thing people talk about before they walk it.
Somebody at {place} has had enough of {quarry}. {count} of them, {marks} marks, and no questions about the middle part.
template.hand_in_text: Tell them at {place} that it is done

stages.journal: It is done. {place} owes {marks} marks and a drink.

name: Hunt
description: Beasts, not people. Hunters' lodges and market towns post these.

board_lines: Bring nothing back. Just make the counting come out lower.
Paid by the head, and we will take your word, mostly.
The dogs will not go out past the stile. That is how many.
Not a monster. Just too many of an ordinary thing, which is worse.
journal: The board at {place} wants {count} {beast} thinned out of {region}. Nobody is calling it brave work. It is just work.
{beast} have got above themselves around {place}. {count} of them, and the price rises the fewer are left.
A hunt, plain and unsung: {count} {beast} in {region}, paid out at {place}.

name: Delivery
description: Something goes from here to there, and the road is the difficulty.

board_lines: Walk, do not run. It is fragile and so is the road.
Do not open it. If it rattles, it was rattling when you got it.
They will know it by the knot. Do not retie the knot.
Paid at the far end, which is the usual argument.
journal: {place} wants {goods} carried to {destination}. The road between is {region}'s own business, and it has opinions.
A package of {goods} for {destination}. {place} says it is not heavy. {place} is not carrying it.
Simple enough: {goods} from {place} to {destination}, {marks} marks on arrival, weather and wolves permitting.

name: Clearing
description: A place has gone wrong and somebody would like it to stop.

board_lines: Take a lantern. Take two. Take somebody who can carry the second one.
We are not asking anyone to be clever about it.
It was quiet for years. It is not quiet now.
Whatever is in there has learned the shape of the doorway. Mind that.
journal: They will not go near {den} any more. {place} is paying to have it made ordinary again: {count} of the {vermin} that have settled in it.
{den} has {vermin} in it and {place} has a board with my name going on it. {count} of them should do it.
Work at {den}: clear out {count} {vermin}. {place} pays {marks} and does not want the details.

stages.journal: Inside {den}. It is as quiet as they said, which is the complaint.

name: Escort
description: Somebody has to go somewhere and would rather not go alone.

board_lines: Not frightened. Sensible. There is a difference and it is being insisted upon.
Pays on arrival, and there will be an opinion about your pace.
Talks the whole way. That is the real fee.
Set out in daylight. That is not a suggestion.
journal: {traveller} is going from {place} to {destination} and would rather do it with somebody who owns a weapon.
An escort out of {place}: {traveller}, bound for {destination}, across as much of {region} as lies between.
{traveller} has waited three days at {place} for company to {destination}. I am the company.

stages.journal: On the road to {destination} with {traveller} talking.
{traveller} is at {destination}, whole, and still talking.

name: Fetch
description: Something is out there and somebody wants it in here.

names: {goods}, and the boy will not go
board_lines: Out past {ground}, if the old stories are worth anything.
Do not bring the wrong thing. It has happened. Twice.
Paid by the piece. Bent ones count as half and we will argue about it then.
The good ones grow where nobody sensible stands.
journal: {place} wants {count} of {goods}. The ones worth having are out towards {ground}, which is why the board is still up.
A gathering job: {count} {goods} from around {ground} in {region}, paid at {place}.
Somebody at {place} needs {goods} and needs it enough to pay {marks} for {count} of them.

stages.journal: Gathered. {place} pays {marks} and will still say they are small.
